Description: Unique identifier for the customs declaration (primary key)
Date the declaration was submitted
The border post where goods entered (Forbes only)
Unique identifier for the importing entity
Country where goods were manufactured
Text description of the goods (one HS code per commodity)
Harmonized System tariff classification code (treat as text label)
Customs risk profile assigned before clearance (Low < Medium < High)
Customs value declared by the importer
Customs value assessed by customs
Duty declared by the importer
Duty assessed by customs
Import VAT declared by the importer
Import VAT assessed by customs
Excise duty declared by the importer (0 for non-excisable goods)
Excise duty assessed by customs
Total revenue declared (duty + VAT + excise)
Total revenue assessed by customs (authoritative total)
Whether a physical inspection took place (Yes/No)
Whether an offence was found (Yes/No); only possible when inspected
Category of offence; 'No Offence' where none was detected
Assessed minus declared total revenue, floored at 0 (estimate, not proof of loss)
Revenue actually recovered following a detected offence
Status of the payment (Paid, Part-paid, Pending)
Data-quality flag: assessed duty+VAT+excise does not equal assessed total
Data-quality flag: assessed < declared (over-declaration), gap recorded as 0
Year-month of the declaration (YYYY-MM); joins to Monthly_Targets
Yes if Potential_Revenue_Gap_USD > 0
Potential revenue gap as % of declared total revenue
